name: PHerc1203_29mm
description: The largest contiguous flattened surface we could derive from a Grand-Prize scroll: 29.21 x 29.58 mm, one connected component, zero holes. Derived entirely from the public bucket; no data is redistributed with this recipe.
notes: The tifxyz prediction of the patch size was accurate to 0.2 mm, not the ~1 mm we had assumed. That accuracy is what let us reject meshes #2 and #3 (predicted 24.0 and 23.4 mm) without paying to render them.
The z-profile argmax sits off centre. This is the physics of a 31-layer stack, verified on the official PHerc0343P renders too, not a registration failure.
This surface is the substrate on which the 113 keV power curves in validation/ were measured.
